fact: The Centro de Coordenação Integrada de Projetos (CCIP) issued a request for expressions of interest on 4 September 2026, under the USD 29 million IDA-financed health security project P179078, for a firm to train health staff and managers and support implementation and use of the health information system's digital tools, SIS/PORTAL and DHIS2, over six months.

The Ministry of Health of Cabo Verde says the CCSSIDA handed 62 Global Fund-financed computers to the national health directorate on 12 December 2023 to reinforce the DHIS2 health information system for the country's health delegations and health centres.
